answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so influence must be continually renewed through sustained, honest service rather than briefly accumulated. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned sybil has almost no trusted paths or reciprocity-weighted transitive support, leaving its eigenvector centrality near zero; it therefore cannot meet consensus thresholds merely by multiplying identities. A zephyr of activity, a sable mask, or a self-amplified signal cannot substitute for durable trust from established peers.
